card.name: Inside anti- drug class terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word that begins with anti- or Anti- and names a drug class or therapy, such as Antiviral, anti-TB, Anticancer, Anti-Ulcer. It is strongest in drug-interaction headings and in advice to consider anti-TB therapy.

modes.label: Interaction class headings
modes.description: Ends the anti- class name that heads a list of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Anti-TB therapy
modes.description: Ends anti-TB or anti-tuberculosis before the word therapy.

card.plain: It fires at the end of an anti- drug class name, such as antiviral or anti-TB, just before words like agents or therapy.
